now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
now.text: Phil Coulson first tracks Robbie Reyes, the new Ghost Rider, as a dangerous killer, but learns he lives by a code. They team up against Eli Morrow and Aida, and Coulson even makes his own deal with the Spirit of Vengeance to stop Aida.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A killer with a code who becomes Coulson's ally as the new Ghost Rider.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The director who hunts Robbie, then teams up with him against Aida.

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The agent who hunts Robbie, then teams up with him against Aida.

changes.evidence: In Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4 Coulson is no longer director: Jeffrey Mace is the new S.H.I.E.L.D. Director, and Coulson and Mack work as agents under him when they track Daisy and the Ghost Rider (S4#1). The card line on Robbie's card calls Coulson 'the director' during this hunt, which is false for that season.

now.title: X-Men (2000)
now.text: Inside the Statue of Liberty, Magneto pins Storm and the X-Men to the walls, and Storm tells him his machine will kill the leaders he means to change.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Pins Storm to the wall inside the Statue of Liberty.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Magneto pins her inside the statue.

proposed.title: X2
proposed.text: Magneto saves Storm and the others when their jet is shot down and joins them against William Stryker at Alkali Lake. He then betrays them, turning Cerebro against humans and flying off in Stryker's helicopter.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An uneasy ally against Stryker, who then betrays the X-Men.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An X-Man who works with Magneto against Stryker, until he betrays them.

changes.evidence: X2: after Magneto saves the downed X-Jet carrying Storm, he and Mystique team up with the X-Men against Stryker at Alkali Lake, then has Xavier turn Cerebro on humans and escapes in Stryker's helicopter, while Storm frees Xavier. This alliance and betrayal sits between the X-Men (2000) stage and the Days of Future Past stage, and no stage covers it.
